scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && node --env-file=.env --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
scripts.sync:osha-cases:if-needed: tsx -e '(async()=>{if(process.env.NODE_ENV!=="production"){console.log("[osha-case-sync] Non-production environment; startup sync skipped.");return;}const {spawn}=await import("node:child_process");const {pool}=await import("@workspace/db");const {ensureOshaCasePersistence}=await import("./src/services/oshaCaseDataService");const year=Number(process.env.OSHA_CASE_DETAIL_YEAR||2025);try{if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL){console.warn("[osha-case-sync] DATABASE_URL is not configured; skipping startup case-detail sync.");return;}await ensureOshaCasePersistence();const result=await pool.query("SELECT count(*)::text AS case_count FROM osha_case_details WHERE dataset_year = $1",[year]);const count=Number(result.rows[0]?.case_count||0);await pool.end();if(count>0){console.log(`[osha-case-sync] OSHA ${year} case detail already loaded (${count.toLocaleString()} rows); startup sync skipped.`);return;}console.log(`[osha-case-sync] OSHA ${year} case detail is missing; starting one-time import.`);await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const child=spawn("pnpm",["exec","tsx","scripts/import-osha-case-detail.ts","--year",String(year)],{stdio:"inherit",env:process.env});child.on("error",reject);child.on("exit",code=>code===0?resolve():reject(new Error(`OSHA case-detail importer exited with code ${code??"unknown"}.`)));});}catch(error){console.error(`[osha-case-sync] ${error instanceof Error?error.message:String(error)}`);try{await pool.end();}catch{}console.warn("[osha-case-sync] Continuing API startup; import will retry on the next restart while the dataset remains missing.");}})()'
